summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting a repurchase of Class XXX Notes (YMCWO) between June 8 and June 12, 2026, for a total of Ps. 21,436,150,457.80 (≈US$14.924M par value) at an average price of 99.93% of nominal value. The notes were originally issued under the Frequent Issuer framework in July 2024 and April 2025, maturing July 2026. Repurchased notes are held in portfolio. This is an ordinary open-market debt repurchase, not a tender offer or special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are involved. The event is a routine capital management transaction with no risk-arb angle.
